title: Background Job Queue Design Plan
description: A structured plan for a background-job system — broker, idempotency, lock, retry, DLQ, and Redis choices — so background-job-queue-design's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/job_queue_design_audit.mjs.

workShape.description: The shape of the work: single side effect, short pipeline, hours-plus workflow, or human-in-the-loop.

handlersIdempotent.description: True if every handler is idempotent with a stable idempotency key derived from the business event.

dedupBackedByDbConstraint.description: True if a DB-level unique constraint backs up any in-Redis dedup (jobId, SET-NX).

expectsExactlyOnce.description: True if the design assumes exactly-once delivery across systems — an anti-pattern; at-least-once is the only honest semantic.

handlerP99Ms.description: Measured p99 handler latency in milliseconds.

handlerExtendsLock.description: True if long handlers extend the lock (job.extendLock / ChangeMessageVisibility) mid-run.

backoffStrategy.description: Retry backoff strategy. Only exponential-full-jitter avoids the thundering herd.

permanentErrorsBypassRetry.description: True if permanent errors (user-not-found, malformed input) skip the retry policy and go straight to the DLQ.

dlqConfigured.description: True if failed jobs land in a dead-letter queue after the retry policy is exhausted.

dlqReplayToolExists.description: True if a tested replay tool exists (replay-by-id, replay-by-range, drain-with-confirmation).

dlqAlertOnGrowthRate.description: True if DLQ alerting fires on growth rate (N/min), not just nonzero count.

redisMaxmemoryPolicy.description: Redis maxmemory-policy for Redis-backed brokers. Must be noeviction or queued jobs are silently evicted.

redisAofEnabled.description: True if Redis AOF persistence is enabled (appendfsync everysec).

gracefulShutdownHandled.description: True if SIGTERM/SIGINT close workers (finish in-flight jobs) before process exit.

queueLevelRateLimiter.description: True if a queue-level limiter caps aggregate downstream calls across all workers.
